result.summary: The main defect is a filter-state mismatch: the 'Pizza' category chip is selected, yet the feed shows mostly non-pizza restaurants. Otherwise the layout, spacing, and typography look consistent; the clipped carousel items and the partially visible card at the bottom are expected behavior.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' filter chip is shown as selected (dark filled state), but the content does not reflect this filter. 'Fastest near you' lists Green Bowl Poké and Smash Bros Burgers, and the first 'Popular right now' card is Tokumaru Ramen Bar (tagged 'Ramen'). The selected chip and the displayed results contradict each other.
issues.suggestion: Make sure selecting a category chip filters the carousels and lists to matching restaurants. If the sections are meant to stay unfiltered, the chip should not appear selected; the default state should highlight 'All'.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has almost no visible circular backdrop, unlike the clearly visible dark circle on the pizza card below. This makes the heart buttons look inconsistent between cards.
issues.suggestion: Use the same semi-opaque circular background for all favorite buttons so they look consistent and stay legible on any image.
